title: Run Jev: paralegal-attorney (3 cells, 3000 requests)
description:
**Not yet runnable, and WAITS FOR THE USER'S EXPLICIT GO.** Jev is an online service reached through its maker's kit and may cost money. Do not start until the user has commented "go" on this issue.

**Job:** answer the registered 500-item subsample of the still-missing Jev cells for this task (see the title for the grid size; the estimate assumed two requests per item and is low).

**Missing before it can run:** the Jev collector and per-task manifests (`docs/jev-runs/`). `scripts/collect_task.py` supports only Kev, so how Jev answers are collected has to be worked out first. Once it is, this run follows the runbook in BD-dd780c with the Jev collector. `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` comes from the environment or a gitignored `.env`; never print, log or commit it.

**Rules:** one job at a time; results go to branch `runs/<this issue id>`, never main; no `bd replay`; never touch `project/`.
